entry.hypothesis: H1 - an ETF whose 3-12 month excess return over T-bills is positive keeps rising; holding only such ETFs, sized inverse to volatility with the rest in BIL, beats owning the universe and 60/40.
entry.rationale: Time-series momentum (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012; Hurst-Ooi-Pedersen 2013) - initial under-reaction and herding make 1-12 month trends persist in every asset class; inverse-vol sizing lets bonds and commodities carry risk comparable to equities.

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
